caller: supervised-win32 public stdio-MCP caller; one max-10,000 ms dispatch wait, then read-only exact-call interface_results polling for at most 15 s
cleanup: one interface_close; close only the exact owned fixture HWND/process; restore only the foreground window that preceded this run; preserve raw on every outcome

decision.fail_or_unknown: Preserve FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN for missing or mismatched dispatch call ID, a retrieval timeout or unknown call, stale generation, missing release/effect, close uncertainty, or any need to retry. Never redispatch.
decision.pass: One new fixture and supervised session yield a distinct public observation generation; one dispatch returns pending; read-only interface_results polls the exact call ID and returns completed within 15 seconds; the retrieved action contains a verified all-up release and producer/neutral-readback receipt; the exact independent fixture effect and event journal match; the interface closes and the owned fixture exits; the prior foreground is restored; task_success remains null.

hypothesis: When a public dispatch returns pending, polling interface_results for its exact call ID within a finite 15-second retrieval budget yields the same terminal completion/release receipt before session close.
nonclaims: this is a new action after R24 and the R25 pre-input refusal, not a retry or continuous transaction
resource_boundary: One new fixture process/window, one new supervised session, one observation, one validation, one dispatch, read-only exact-call result retrieval for at most 15 s, one public close. No WSLc/Docker, external window, replay, retry, cancellation, fallback input, or registry changes.

retrieval.call_id_source: the exact call_id returned by this attempt interface_dispatch

retry_policy: One input-free preflight, one dispatch, and finite read-only retrieval of that exact call ID. Any retrieval timeout stays UNKNOWN; never redispatch.

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe and independently matched to the new fixture

trial.observation_region: the exact GetClientRect width and height of this new owned fixture
trial.task_effect_oracle: independently read effect.json and exact fixture events.jsonl after public dispatch; require one click, exact UTF-16 character sequence, and one save
